A giant starburst bloom crowns a lush green beanstalk-vine that leans and sways in slow curves, its surface tangled with tendrils and spangled with tiny ivory side-flowers.
One enormous trumpet-form bloom flares at the sky-piercing top of a thick, soft green vine-stem wrapped in overlapping leaves and threading tendrils from root to crown.
A massive multi-petaled bloom glows at the peak of a vine-stalk that zigzags gently as it climbs, its green surface dense with curling leaves and clusters of unopened buds.
A single gargantuan bloom, fringed and layered, tops a supple green flower-vine that corkscrews as it soars, trailing long trailing leaves and delicate clinging tendrils all up its length.
One giant cupped bloom at redwood height is cradled by the curved, leaf-padded tip of a thick green vine-stalk whose lower coils are hidden beneath a canopy of its own leaves.
A colossal spherical bloom crowns a gently undulating green stem, its vine-body knobbed with leaf-nodes and wrapped in spiraling tendrils the whole dizzying distance to the ground.
One titanic flat-faced bloom stares straight up into the sky from the swaying top of a leafy green vine-stalk, smaller buds lining its curving length like ornaments on a living rope.
A single magnificent bloom arches over at its redwood-tall apex, the soft green vine-stem below it bending gracefully, smothered in tendrils, leaves, and chains of tiny budding flowers.
